svg.title: Simulated RF delivery probability
svg.desc: Distance-based model from living_map_radio.model, not hardware measurements. Each crossed wall adds eight decibels. Three curves show zero, one and two walls; transmission probability is zero strictly beyond the equivalent twenty-two-metre limit.
svg.text: Walls shorten the link. Relays restore the path.
Simulation model from model.py · 8 dB per wall · no measured RF data claimed
